purpose: Reproduce the fixed v8 missing-clock scientific route under an isolated run root using independently rebuilt parent evidence; never reuse original-run byte fingerprints as authentication

run_isolation.publication_trust_boundary: The CLI SHA is an operator-supplied publication attestation: byte equality alone cannot prove that the source was publicly committed. The operator must verify the published commit/source SHA before invoking any real mode.

parent_manifest_contract.paths: all paths relative to run root, resolved with strict containment and no symlink escape
parent_manifest_contract.validation: before any Parquet value read, rehash every named parent/source byte and verify recursive v5-to-v7 lineage, source/parameter/schema/split identity and exact role paths; repeat afterward; replay saved fold/audit models on exact heldout IDs and replay fixed scores and paired UTC-day confidence gates
parent_manifest_contract.producer_receipt_required_outputs: v5 receipt must bind v5 OOF, protocol, validation report and all v5_model_* bytes; v7 receipt must bind v7 OOF, protocol, validation report, ranking predictions and manifest, and all v7_model_* bytes
parent_manifest_contract.producer_receipt_required_inputs: each receipt must bind SHA-256 of all 12 raw training months, raw ranking, submission template, baseline training/ranking rows and features, ARR training/ranking caches, and NOAA weather from this isolated run root

scientific_route.replica_of: accepted local v8 movement_only_expert plus compose_current_candidate missing-clock route
scientific_route.feature_schema: exact SAFE_CACHED_NUMERIC + SAFE_CACHED_CATEGORICAL + DERIVED_COLUMNS + wx_* from published movement source + ARRIVAL_COLUMNS in original order; 13 categorical columns
scientific_route.training_target: 2025 departure target finite and 0..7200 seconds, cast float32
scientific_route.internal_early_stop: eligible complementary-month row with absolute Unix-epoch UTC day modulo 11 equal to zero; excluded months never fit or early stop
scientific_route.gate: nonfinite baseline proxy AND AOBT_3_flt_missing AND LOBT_flt_missing AND airport != LIRF; only finite heldout labels scored
scientific_route.selection_check: January/July all-finite RMSE selects 1.0 with smaller-weight tie rule; the unchanged fixed weight improves both original folds and paired UTC-day 1000-resample CI lower bounds are positive
scientific_route.fresh_april_october: fit movement and accepted v5 ordinary direct CatBoost 700-cap depth6 70-patience only on complementary months; one fixed weight1 comparison, both months RMSE and pooled UTC-day CI lower bound positive
scientific_route.reserved_february_august: same paired refits and fixed gate for February/August, both months RMSE and pooled UTC-day CI lower bound positive
scientific_route.final_model: all ordinary 2025 departures, integer median of only original two fold best rounds, identical LightGBM params and feature schema
scientific_route.ranking: after every gate, exact template ID order, clip selected v7 ranking reference plus fixed movement-only correction only on the no-NM invalid-AOBT non-LIRF gate, all other rows bytewise equal in values, finite and nonnegative

reproduction_limit: This driver covers the v8 scientific missing-clock route only. Independent clean v5 and v7 builders, their producer receipts, and separate v9-v13 adapters are prerequisites and are not supplied by this file. An isolated run provides new provenance and local validation; it does not claim byte-identical outputs or official score transfer.
